name: HardMixedBudget

name: HardUnsolvedIsFree
purpose: An unsolved live child is not a zero-cost solution.

name: HardTerminalFree
purpose: Terminal execution is included in the hard online budget.

name: HardResetPast
purpose: Resetting the current bit does not identify its immutable origin.

name: HardPreState

name: HardSimultaneousMax
purpose: Different resource coordinates may attain their maxima on different traces.

name: HardSensorTwoRecords
purpose: One observation with two possible reports requires three literal records.

name: HardTerminalAtZero

name: BinaryStorageOnly

name: BinaryWorkOnly
purpose: Minimum work alone does not certify minimum literal storage.

name: BinaryWrongLeaves

name: BinaryResetCounts
purpose: A destructive reset invalidates immutable-origin case counting.

name: BinaryUniversalCounts

name: BinaryTerminalFree

name: BinaryNonbinaryAlphabet

name: BinaryIgnoredUnary
purpose: A redundant unary query still occupies an installed record.

name: BinaryNoInformativeQueries
purpose: A numerical lower bound does not supply a missing diagnostic query.

name: BinaryShortHorizon
purpose: Eight singleton cases cannot be diagnosed by two binary reports.

name: BinaryRejectedMeansImpossible

name: BinaryScopeByName
purpose: An actual changed transition table does not inherit its old scope certificate.

name: SynthesisProbeKey
purpose: Finite probe agreement does not justify the key soundness needed for candidate deletion.

name: SynthesisFiniteFit

name: SynthesisLaterAST
purpose: Returning another equivalent syntax does not preserve the literal teacher trace.

name: SynthesisForgetEvidence
purpose: Dropping an older counterexample can cause literal repeated submission.

name: SynthesisGlobalExhaustion
purpose: Finite-grammar exhaustion is not impossibility outside that grammar.

name: SynthesisAllCandidatesCalled
purpose: The teacher-call bound is not an equality requiring every syntax to be proposed.

name: SynthesisTeacherFree
purpose: Semantic compression does not reduce the unchanged complete teacher work.

name: SynthesisSetupFree
purpose: Nonzero index preparation can exceed the saved retained-example tests.

name: SynthesisPauseIsExhaustion
purpose: An actual suspension is neither a complete scan nor a grammar-exhaustion certificate.

name: SynthesisContextOrder
purpose: Changing teacher context order can change the counterexample history.

name: SynthesisIncompleteContexts
purpose: A complete context order must include every admitted context.

name: SynthesisChangedTarget
purpose: The target cannot change while retaining the same outcome certificate.

name: PrefixTotalHeadroom
purpose: The total number of unread rows must fit both child capacities.

name: PrefixRejectsEquality
purpose: Equality with capacity is not grounds for rejecting the query.

name: PrefixOverfullCanRecover
purpose: Unseen reports cannot reduce an already overfull branch.

name: PrefixFiniteFitAuthority
purpose: A finite fit does not license rejecting a feasible larger-capacity prefix.

name: PrefixCapacitySuffices

name: PrefixDuplicateCases

name: PrefixResetScope
purpose: Destructive reset invalidates singleton identification by initial cardinality.

name: PrefixSharedRepair
purpose: One repair can cover several cases after a language change.

name: PrefixChangedOrder
purpose: Changing query order need not preserve the literal first returned tree.

name: PrefixIncompleteMenu
purpose: Search failure with an incomplete query catalogue is not model infeasibility.

name: PrefixReadOnlySpeedup
purpose: Fewer table reads need not reduce a combined event cost.

name: PrefixOmittedPermission
purpose: The probability/report table does not replace the permission check.

name: RevisionOmittedDependency
purpose: An unrecorded input defeats semantic completeness.

name: RevisionLocalReplayTruth
purpose: Passing a local-only test does not establish its missing global claim.

name: RevisionDirectOnly
purpose: An unchanged direct record can depend on a stale parent.

name: RevisionUncheckedOld
purpose: Old local PASS flags do not replace established old claims.

name: RevisionCyclicRanking
purpose: A dependency cycle has no topological rank.

name: RevisionStaleIsFalse
purpose: Stale does not imply a false mathematical claim.

name: RevisionMissingIsFalse
purpose: Missing evidence can concern a true claim.

name: RevisionRejectedIsFalse
purpose: Rejecting a supplied witness does not refute the target.

name: RevisionParentOptional
purpose: A locally successful flag cannot bypass an unavailable parent.

name: RevisionOldBound
purpose: The old general lower bound fails after a universal repair is admitted.

name: RevisionOldProfile
purpose: A valid replacement does not inherit the old numerical profile.

name: RevisionExternalOptional
purpose: Unchanged syntax cannot restore an unavailable external assurance.

name: PricesFewerReadsIsSaving

name: PricesNegativeAllowed

name: PricesZeroStrict

name: PricesSetupOmitted
purpose: A positive per-use margin does not erase preparation.

name: PricesBreakEvenStrict
purpose: Break-even equality is not strict improvement.

name: PricesOneGoodPriceIsAll

name: PricesNaturalSubtraction
purpose: Natural subtraction truncates increased costs to zero.

name: PricesUnmatchedUnits

name: PricesValidQuoteMeansBenefit

name: PricesOldQuoteReusable
purpose: An old numerical quote is stale after its price changes.

name: PricesChangingPricesCancel

name: PricesEmptyMinimizer

name: LineageSelectedNominal
purpose: Fixed-candidate marginal validity cannot be substituted for selected-attempt conditional validity.

name: LineageBudgetLabel
purpose: A numerical schedule alone gives no false-acceptance guarantee.

name: LineageDisjointReuse
purpose: Two disjoint half-error events require a total budget of one.

name: LineageDependentEquality
purpose: Countable subadditivity does not imply equality for overlapping dependent events.

name: LineageRetainedConditional
purpose: The stopped unconditional event bound is not a bound conditional on retention.

name: LineageNullEmpty
purpose: Zero probability need not mean an empty event.

name: LineageFinitePrefix
purpose: An error-free finite prefix does not establish an all-time guarantee.

name: LineageDivergentBudget
purpose: A divergent real tsum defaults to zero and cannot serve as a valid total error budget.

name: JointDisplayAlone
purpose: The accessible display alone cannot reconstruct the physical target, even with an arbitrary nonlinear decoder.

name: JointCalibrationAlone
purpose: The accessible calibration alone cannot reconstruct the physical target.

name: JointKernelDropsRecord
purpose: The common ambiguity is the intersection of record kernels, not one individual kernel.

name: JointNuisanceFullState
purpose: Reconstructing the protected target does not reconstruct an additional invisible nuisance coordinate.

name: JointTargetNeedsInjectivity
purpose: The proved target factorization does not require injectivity of the record map.

name: JointRangeNeedsSurjective
purpose: A full-domain decoder can exist when some formal record values are unattainable.

name: JointUniqueExtension
purpose: Two full-domain decoders can agree on every attained record and differ outside the record range.

name: JointCalibrationStillHidden
purpose: The exact source two-dimensional joint record recovers calibration as well as the physical bit.

name: LegalLabelsMayVary
purpose: Equal quotient fibres must preserve the protected label even when no actions are enabled.

name: LegalPermissionsOmitted
purpose: Equal sensor labels do not permit merging states with different repair permissions.

name: LegalSuccessorOmitted
purpose: Equal labels and enabled sets are insufficient when legal successors leave different quotient states.

name: LegalPredictorAuthorizesRepair
purpose: A good shared sensor label does not authorize a repair that the encoded interface disables.

name: LegalFullSuccessorEquality
purpose: A valid quotient preserves projected successors; it need not preserve forgotten fine-state history.

name: LegalRepeatRepair
purpose: A repair can disable a later repair, so legality must be checked along the full sequence.

name: LegalEmptyTraceNoLabel
purpose: The empty action word retains its initial protected label.

name: LegalOffImageUnique
purpose: Without surjectivity, two factoring quotients may differ off the record image.

name: LegalDisabledDefaultUnique
purpose: Arbitrary totalized values at disabled actions are not unique operational successors.
